business_summary: Nankai Chemical Company,Limited manufacturers and sells chemical in Japan and internationally. The company offers inorganic industrial chemicals, water treatment disinfectants, water treatment agents, healthy foods, sulfuric acid recycling, and pesticides, as well as salt. It is also involved in the manufacturing and distribution of chemical industry products, pharmaceuticals, pesticides, cosmetics, quasi-drugs, and food additives; development and analysis of chemical industry products, pharmaceuticals, pesticides, cosmetics, quasi-drugs, foods and food additives; collection, transportation, and intermediate treatment of industrial waste; manufacturing, processing, and distribution of salt; distribution and recovery of precious metals, non-ferrous metals, and other bullions and their salts; distribution of precision machinery, textile machinery, plating equipment, paint equipment, and building materials; import/export of technologies and products; equipment engineering and management maintenance business; parking lot, and real estate management and warehousing; and consignment and agency services of accounting, general affairs, and personnel affairs research, development, production, and sale of agricultural, livestock, and marine products; freight transport and handling; calibration; management and operation of power generation; and electricity supply and sales business. Nankai Chemical Company,Limited was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 난카이 케미컬 컴퍼니(Nankai Chemical Company)는 일본 및 국제적으로 화학 물질을 제한적으로 제조 및 판매합니다. 무기산업화학물질, 수처리 살균제, 수처리제, 건강식품, 황산재활용, 살충제, 소금 등을 판매하는 회사입니다. 또한 화학공업제품, 의약품, 농약, 화장품, 의약외품, 식품첨가물 등의 제조 및 유통업도 하고 있습니다. 화학공업제품, 의약품, 농약, 화장품, 의약외품, 식품 및 식품첨가물의 개발 및 분석; 산업 폐기물의 수집, 운송 및 중간 처리; 소금의 제조, 가공, 유통; 귀금속, 비철금속, 기타 금괴 및 그 염의 유통 및 회수; 정밀 기계, 섬유 기계, 도금 장비, 페인트 장비, 건축 자재 유통; 기술 및 제품의 수입/수출; 장비 엔지니어링 및 관리 유지 보수 사업; 주차장, 부동산 관리 및 창고업; 회계·총무·인사 연구·개발·생산 업무의 위탁 및 대행 업무
